name: vwap_crossover_flow_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: VWAP crossovers with volume surge signal institutional flow direction change. When a stock crosses above VWAP on 3x volume after spending 30+ bars below it, institutional buyers are stepping in. The crossover itself becomes a magnet for TWAP algorithms that benchmark to VWAP. Edge persists because the timing of institutional flow shifts is unpredictable — you can only detect them in real-time via the volume-confirmed VWAP cross.

indicators.name: bars_below_vwap
indicators.formula: count of consecutive bars with close < vwap

indicators.name: bars_above_vwap
indicators.formula: count of consecutive bars with close > vwap

long.confirmation: cross bar closes in top 25% of its range

short.confirmation: cross bar closes in bottom 25% of its range

exit.stop_loss: close crosses back below/above VWAP (whichever invalidates trade)

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.trend_filter: trade in direction of VWAP cross
other_filters: bars below/above VWAP must be > 30 — quick oscillations around VWAP are noise

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VWAP benchmarking is institutional infrastructure, not going away

weaknesses: VWAP is recalculated continuously — cross can be marginal and flip back on next bar
30-bar threshold means signal fires relatively late in the move
On choppy days, price crosses VWAP many times but none stick — stop loss triggered repeatedly
prior_art: VWAP crossover trading — institutional execution concept. Volume-confirmed version is the edge.
notes: Consider weighting the 30-bar threshold by time-of-day — fewer bars needed in morning when VWAP is less stable.
